question: Why should the same reasoning not be wrongly objected to in the case of ego?
premises: The same reasoning applies in the case of ego.
An objection would ignore this applicability.
The address rebukes such idle objection.
inference: Therefore, one should not object by prattling against this reasoning in the case of ego.
plain_english: Do not prattle, O learned one, saying that this same reasoning applies also in the case of ego.
